description: Icelandic company register (Fyrirtækjaskrá, Skatturinn): search companies by name (kennitala/ID number, name, address), or look up one company by its 10-digit kennitala for the full public record: name, registration date, other names, postal and legal address, municipality, legal form (ehf., hf., sf....), officers listed by the register, ÍSAT industry classification, and VAT numbers with registration dates. Related tools on this server, for a different need: b2b_nz_companies_register when you need New Zealand Companies Register search: company name; b2b_bolagsverket_sweden_companies when you need Swedish company register record by 10-digit organisation. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

kennitala.description: 10-digit company ID (kennitala), e.g. 4612023490, for the full record

name.description: Company name to search, e.g. icelandair
